A newly provided checker exhaustively compares all bivariate rank coefficients in several prime-field cases, including mixed Jordan lengths; experiments only corroborate the proof. value.rationale: Commuting retractions are compatible split Lie-algebra decompositions, a natural invariant of the endomorphism monoid. The theorem determines the full bivariate rank law over all nonsingular actions, all dimensions and all finite characteristics, not an arbitrary slice or single-table recomputation. The squarefree formula exposes arithmetic dependence on irreducible factor degrees; the irreducible specialization q^(2d)-q^d noncommuting affine lifts is an actual structural obstruction invisible to the familiar commuting module projectors. The exact statistic can be used to compare split-decomposition geometry and commutation probabilities.
